title: Equality of the Helly and Radon numbers for connected graphs under $\Delta$-convexity
statement:
Let $G$ be a non-trivial connected graph. Write $h_\Delta(G)$ for its Helly number and $r_\Delta(G)$ for its Radon number with respect to $\Delta$-convexity.

**Helly–Radon equality conjecture.**

$$
h_\Delta(G)=r_\Delta(G).
$$

The conjecture proposes that, unlike in most familiar convexities on discrete structures, the Helly and Radon numbers coincide for every non-trivial connected graph under $\Delta$-convexity. The equality is established in the paper for chordal graphs, and the authors report it for all small graphs examined, but it remains open in general.
source_name: Bijo S Anand, Arun Anil, Manoj Changat, Revathy S. Nair and Prasanth G. Narasimha-Shenoi, “Helly Number, Radon Number and Rank in Δ-Convexity on Graphs”, arXiv:2411.10816 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.10816

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2024).
